latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Editor Text Generator skill.
- Upload video clips (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) to generate 1080p MP4 videos with AI-generated on-screen text and captions.
- Automatic cloud setup: connects to backend, handles session/token creation, and guides user through setup.
- Supports video upload, text overlay generation, credits check, status queries, and video export.
- Works with a variety of input/output media formats and provides clear feedback for errors and status updates.
